Penalty for SSDiD

penalty.Rd

The regularization term \eta^2 for SSDiD estimator without s2.

Usage

penalty(N, deg = 0.9)

Arguments

N

Numeric.

deg

Numeric. The default value of 0.9 is proposed in the paper in Remark 3.2.

Value

 Numeric. The penalty term without s2.
